title: MIR 3.2.5 unified research cost curves
migration_impact: Adds stable startup settings for an additive per-level cost increment. Defaults are zero, existing setting IDs remain stable, unchanged external formulas remain byte-for-byte unchanged, and no model-selection dropdown is introduced.
release_note_impact: Consolidated 3.2.5 research-cost and compatibility notes required

backport_disposition.factorio-2.1: canonical implementation incorporated into the single MIR 3.2.5 convergence release
backport_disposition.factorio-2.0: continuously project with the 3.2.5 compatibility slice and independently qualify as MIR 2.5.5
